results.question: How many documents are in the knowledge graph?
results.cypher: MATCH (d:Document) RETURN count(d) AS document_count LIMIT 50

results.question: How many people are in the knowledge graph?
results.cypher: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN count(p) AS person_count LIMIT 1

results.question: How many locatedIn relationships are there in the graph?
results.cypher:
MATCH ()-[:locatedIn]->()
RETURN count(*) AS locatedInCount
LIMIT 50

results.question: How many distinct organizations are mentioned in cluster 4?
results.cypher: MATCH (d:Document {cluster_id: 4})-[:mentions]->(o:Organization) RETURN count(DISTINCT o) AS count LIMIT 1

results.question: How many distinct people are mentioned in documents of cluster 19?
results.cypher:
MATCH (d:Document {cluster_id: 19})-[:mentions]->(p:Person)
RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS distinct_people
LIMIT 50

results.question: How many documents from cluster 7 are in the graph?
results.cypher: MATCH (d:Document) WHERE d.cluster_id = 7 RETURN count(d) AS document_count LIMIT 50

results.question: Which locations are mentioned in cluster 15?
results.cypher: MATCH (d:Document {cluster_id: 15})-[:mentions]->(l:Location) RETURN DISTINCT l.name AS location_name LIMIT 50

results.question: Which events are mentioned in cluster 12?
results.cypher: MATCH (d:Document {cluster_id: 12})-[:mentions]->(e:Event) RETURN e.name AS event_name LIMIT 50

results.question: How many distinct topics are the documents in cluster 6 about?
results.cypher: MATCH (d:Document {cluster_id: 6})-[:about]->(t:Topic) RETURN count(DISTINCT t) AS topic_count LIMIT 50

results.question: Which clusters have documents that mention nasa?
results.cypher:
MATCH (d:Document)-[:mentions]->(e)
WHERE toLower(e.name) CONTAINS 'nasa'
RETURN DISTINCT d.cluster_id AS cluster_id
LIMIT 50

results.cypher:

results.cypher:

results.question: Which organizations appear in both cluster 0 and cluster 18?
results.cypher:
MATCH (d0:Document {cluster_id: 0})-[:mentions]->(org:Organization)
MATCH (d18:Document {cluster_id: 18})-[:mentions]->(org)

results.question: Which people are mentioned in more than one cluster?
results.gold_cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[:mentions]->(p:Person) WITH p, count(DISTINCT d.cluster_id) AS clusters WHERE clusters > 1 RETURN p.name
results.cypher:
MATCH (d:Document)-[:mentions]->(p:Person)
WITH p, COUNT(DISTINCT d.cluster_id) AS clusterCount
WHERE clusterCount > 1
RETURN p.name AS personName
LIMIT 50

results.question: How many locations are mentioned in more than one cluster?
results.gold_cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[:mentions]->(l:Location) WITH l, count(DISTINCT d.cluster_id) AS clusters WHERE clusters > 1 RETURN count(l)
results.cypher:
MATCH (loc:Location)-[:mentions]->(doc:Document)
WITH loc.name AS loc_name, COLLECT(DISTINCT doc.cluster_id) AS clusters
WHERE SIZE(clusters) > 1
RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT loc_name) AS location_count
